text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kikuka Sho, the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah, I know Mejiro Ardan's supposed to be making an appearance, but come on. Yaeno Muteki's getting the win, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Not even Mejiro Ramonu has ever run in a 3,000-meter race before. It's probably gonna be tough for her little sister to pull off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (What is this… sensation? I've never felt such pressure before…)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You feel it too, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I also sensed the presence of a fearsome foe. At first, I thought that to be you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now though, I realize it must be her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Her?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ardan, Yaeno! Hello there, you two.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm just so pleased to be running with you both today! ♪ I won't be holding back one bit, though.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So let's all do our best and have a fantastic race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, likewise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Super Creek is a kind, caring Umamusume and a motherly figure to all.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Seeing her today, though…)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll see you on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …It's like seeing a different person entirely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I can feel it… Underneath that loving smile of hers hides a hardened resolve that threatens to devour everyone present today.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This is exhilarating.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can think of nothing better than another mighty opponent to face.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: For the fiercer the struggle, the further we are able to go beyond our limits.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …That is what you're thinking, yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You can tell?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I may not get to spend as much time with you as Chiyono O does, but I do regard myself as your close friend.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …It's in your expression.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm extraordinarily embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now, I will take my leave as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (…I imagine that this race will prove to be another irreplaceable moment.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The final Triple Crown race… Here I come.
